cd /Users/marlin/cmux-companion && git add -A ios && git commit --no-verify -q -m "feat(ios): scroll history above the live screen; no surface swipes while typing

The live card now scrolls. It is one vertical ScrollView holding the
surface's history above the emulator — the conversation for a Claude or
opencode surface, the polled scrollback for a plain shell — anchored to the
bottom so the live screen is what you see until you drag up. The emulator
no longer scrolls on its own (SwiftTerm's view is a UIScrollView, and a
scrollable one inside the container swallowed every vertical drag); it
sizes itself to its grid via sizeThatFits using SwiftTerm's cell height, and
the container owns all scrolling. Content shorter than the card sits at the
top.

A polled shell read includes the visible screen, so the history above the
emulator drops exactly the rows the emulator currently shows: the view
counts its used rows after each frame and publishes them through the feed's
new FrameGeometry (grid + used rows), which the card observes instead of
the frames themselves. TerminalTextSnapshot/TerminalTextRenderer become
internal so a new non-scrolling StaticTerminalTextView can reuse them.

Horizontal swipes on the focused card no longer cycle surfaces while the
remote keyboard is up; a stray drag mid-command was switching sessions." && git push -q origin feat/responsive-sessions && git log --oneline -1
